fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the suspicious gNB/eNodeB via OSS with immediate RAN segmentation rules.
Enforce NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE threshold alerts for values >120 in NEF logs.
Deploy IMSI-based blacklisting in AMF for known rogue IMSIs (KPI: <5% false positives).
Enable NAS security mode enforcement (SM4/SNOW) for all NAS messages.
Configure NAS message replay detection with 3-second timestamp tolerance.
Set NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE counter to trigger automated AMF re-authentication.
Update RAN to enforce NAS integrity protection (IPA) for all NAS messages.
Implement NAS message rate limiting (10 messages/minute per UE).
Audit NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE logs for anomalies in NEF with 15-minute intervals.
Deploy NAS message signature validation for all NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE values.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
